verdict.rationale: Anrok is an API-driven tax SaaS, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair question to ask, but the evidence pack never mentions a sandbox, test mode, or separate non-production account. The createEphemeral endpoint only previews a tax calculation without saving it, which is a dry-run on a single call rather than an isolated sandbox environment, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
